name: alternative wire & cable
old_description: Alternative Wire & Cable distributes copper wire, magnet wire, wire & cable, electrical insulation, motors, motor parts, shop equipment & test equipment to the electrical OEM and motor repair markets. We make our customers our top priority.
about:
Alternative Wire & Cable operates from Blue Springs, Missouri, serving the Midwestern United States as a distributor of electrical wire, cable, insulation, motors, and related equipment. The company’s founding year and ownership structure are not publicly disclosed.

The company distributes a broad range of products including copper wire, magnet wire, wire and cable, electrical insulation materials such as mica, flexible and rigid insulation, lacing and banding, adhesives and sealants, pressure-sensitive tape, terminals and connectors, as well as motors, motor parts, shop equipment, and test equipment. It serves electrical OEMs and motor repair shops across the Midwest.

Primary customers are electrical original equipment manufacturers and motor repair facilities, with a focus on apparatus repair and electrical OEM sites in the Midwestern United States. The company also supplies materials for electrical insulation applications in industrial and commercial settings.

Alternative Wire & Cable states its mission is to be the premier service and solutions provider for electrical insulation materials to apparatus repair and electrical OEM sites in the Midwestern United States, emphasizing customer priority and regional expertise.
